name: ToiletF*cker
source:
Kathy is the landlord of an apartment building that mainly hosts autonomous robot citizens called MechaHumans. Among them, the most familiar to her is the gruff and unreliable plumber-bot named Benny.

When Benny is late on his rent again, Kathy decides to investigate why. The reason will leave her flushed...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240502235655/https://sauceco.itch.io/toiletfcker]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯西是一栋公寓楼的房东，该公寓楼主要居住着名为MechaHumans的自主机器人公民。其中，她最熟悉的是那个粗暴且不可靠的水管工机器人，名叫本尼。

当本尼再次迟交房租时，凯西决定调查原因。这个理由会让她脸红……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240502235655/https://sauceco.itch.io/toiletfcker]itch.io[/url]]
